name: Apatornis
sum: Late Cretaceous ornithuran from the Niobrara Chalk of Kansas, one of the first Mesozoic birds named.
holotype: A partial specimen named by Marsh (1873); a more complete referred skeleton is now Iaceornis.
material: The holotype; the more complete specimen once referred here belongs to Iaceornis.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Marsh 1873
